* Explores RESTful APIs, HTTP integration, CRUD operations, REST constraints, and HTTP status codes.

cases.question: Am I automatically enrolled in the BCITSA Health and Dental Plan, and can I opt out?
cases.standalone_question: Am I automatically enrolled in the BCITSA Health and Dental Plan, and can I opt out?
cases.answer_excerpt:
Yes, you are automatically enrolled in the BCITSA Health and Dental Plan if your program is designated as full-time by BCIT and lasts for at least 16 weeks, and you can opt out if you already have comparable coverage.

- **Automatic Enrollment:** If you meet the criteria of being in a full-time program lasting 16 weeks or longer, the Student Association Health fee is automatically included in your tuition upon registration.
- **Opt-Out Process:** If you are already covered by comparable extended health and dental benefits, you have the option to decline or opt out of the plan. The deadline to submit an opt-out is 30 days from the start of your program (once per 12 months), and extensions or late requests cannot be processed after this deadline.

Sources
- https://www.bcit.ca/admission/tuition-fees/full-time-studies/
- https://www.bcitsa.ca/student-services/health-dental/

prior_turns.question: Tell me about the BCITSA Health and Dental Plan.

cases.answer_excerpt:
You have 30 days from the start of your program to opt out of the BCITSA Health & Dental Plan. 

Key details regarding opting out:
- The opt-out window is valid once per 12 months.
- After this 30-day deadline passes, opt-outs and family add-ons can no longer be processed.
- You are eligible to opt out if you already have another active and comparable extended health and dental plan.
